Pre-SRFI Reference Implementation of Hash Tables

This package contains a preliminary implementation of a hash table API that has been proposed by John Cowan, chair of Working Group 2 (R7RS large).

Implementation

This package imports (scheme base), (r6rs hashtables), and (srfi 114 comparators). It also imports (scheme char) if that library is available.

Tests

in-progress/hash/tables-test.sps tests both (in-progress hash tables) and (in-progress hash bimaps), so both of those libraries will have to be downloaded before their test program can be run.

Bugs

Please report bugs found within (in-progress *) libraries at Larceny's GitHub site.
